prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a single original Quackies "Most Rested" tabletop marker concept, landscape 1536x1024.
The reference is the user's approved token-art family. Match its crisp goofy cartoon language, bold dark teal outlines, saturated printed colours, cream cardboard thickness and short soft contact shadow. Preserve this physical board-game feel; no figurine or glossy plastic.
Create ONE large standalone die-cut marker in the centre, on clean warm ivory background. Its silhouette is a broad low softly scalloped cloud, compact enough to cover one board space. Pale lavender-blue printed face, a thick midnight-indigo rim inside the fine cream cardboard edge, and a small warm golden crescent moon tucked into the upper-left of the face.
On the face show exactly "zzz" as three bold playful dark-navy lowercase z letters increasing slightly in size toward the right, beautifully readable. These are sleep letters, not three separate tokens. Add at most two tiny restrained star marks as part of the illustration.
Header "QUACKIES · MOST RESTED". Caption below the marker "Most Rested marker".
No number badge, forward arrow, shield, feather, duck portrait, resource icon, board scene or extra pieces. No instruction footer making claims about every Night: the final Night has a different reward. No excessive grain, cloth/pillow photorealism, fuzzy edges, watermark or cropped art.
This marker is passed to the Most Rested duck, and later covers the next space beyond its Feather trail as a temporary head start. Illustrate the marker itself only, not an invented board layout.
